original.evidence_scope: New solid trunk and lower-window return: NO inherited directional/narrow native approval. No enemies/rewards/seed variation/Boss integration yet.
original.identity: one solid trunk with an upper forward window and a lower inward return to another root

play_contract.counterexample: Compare ordinary jump/recoil at the upper window and a no-enemy lower return; bind the two exit ports to genuinely different world nodes.
play_contract.decision: Cross the upper window toward the crown, or use the outer-root descent to approach the lower opening and return inward.
play_contract.observe: Two openings belong to one real trunk. The upper crown and the lower inward root are separate destinations.
play_contract.recovery: The solid inner root and outer root receive failed crossings; they must connect into the world's root loop, not a copied ladder.
